integrity: The theorem is proved for every integer \(n\ge3\). Exhaustive finite enumeration through \(n=9\) is corroborative only and is not used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The classification is restricted to standard sunlet graphs with one pendant leaf at every cycle vertex.
A recent Rice dissertation was only available through indexed passages in the access path used for the literature comparison; unseen passages are a residual originality risk.
title: Cardinality enumerator of connected forcing sets of sunlet graphs
